state/queue-refused/

/.n, one line ` `: bin/lib/queue-closed.sh qc_refusal_note, called by bin/triage-shard.sh after the call-guard answers. It counts `call-guard repeat` refusals IN A ROW for one key and only gates a drop of the READY-QUEUE line (the queue file and the D1 ready rows stay the record). Deleted on any other outcome and at the drop; files older than QUEUE_REFUSED_KEEP_S are pruned on every call. Losing it costs at most N more refusals at $0. Machine-local, never carried
